note: The rebels' words are unmarked, as in the Latin; the blind reader heard them as the reciter's own call to break the kings' chains. Quotation marks are the option, but would force marking every other turn of voice.
D17: God speaking to his Anointed says *tu*: *Tu és meu Filho, eu hoje te gerei*. *Vós sois meu Filho* is the option, but puts distance where the Latin is most intimate.
D18, the homograph ban's highest price: *Sede servos do Senhor*, because *Servi ao Senhor* is also "I served the Lord". The Latinist (twice) and the stylist asked for *Servi*; it is one touch away.
*fora do caminho justo*, held against the Latinist's repeated major (*pereçais do caminho justo*), because *perecer de* names the cause of death (D20). *longe do* is the other option.
